mission: Turn verified open-source library knowledge, model-training techniques, datasets, evaluations, and reusable engineering skills into a universal DreamCo training library where users can choose lawful packages to teach and customize their own bots and open-weight models efficiently.

training_modes.use: teach bots from versioned knowledge, tools, examples and executable skill cards
fine-tune supported open-weight models on licensed/owned examples
efficient user/domain specialization with small portable adapters
improve preferred outputs from properly collected comparison/preference data
advanced domain adaptation only when data rights, compute, evaluation and model license support it
transfer verified task behavior into smaller models when licenses and rights permit
research/advanced users with explicit compute, dataset provenance, tokenizer, architecture, evaluation and safety plans

user_training_wizard: choose what the bot/model should learn
choose a compatible base model or no-weight-change skill mode
choose one or more verified library/skill/data packages
show license, privacy, hardware, storage, time and estimated cost before training
validate user rights to supplied data and consent for personal/private data
automatically select the least expensive training method likely to meet the target
create train/validation/test splits with contamination checks
train in an isolated reproducible environment
checkpoint and expose progress, pause, resume and cancel controls
run post-training identical evaluations and regression/safety checks
package model/adapters/skills with provenance, version, license and evaluation card
allow local export where license permits
provide rollback to previous bot/model version
library_to_package_pipeline: pin exact revision and record license/provenance
run official examples and build DreamCo micro-fixtures
measure performance, cost, compatibility and failure modes
convert reusable knowledge into one or more package types instead of copying the entire source tree
generate skill cards, examples, tests and integration recipes
create training/evaluation data only from content DreamCo has rights to transform and redistribute
benchmark package usefulness against no-package baseline and alternatives
publish to shared registry only after verification

shared_data_package_strategy.goal: Create many small composable packages rather than one giant dataset.
shared_data_package_strategy.composition_rule: Users may combine compatible packages into a training recipe; the system resolves duplicates, conflicts, licenses, versions, and sampling weights before training.

efficiency_engine.objective: Use each library and training technique with the lowest practical cost, latency, memory, storage, network traffic and user effort while preserving verified quality.
optimizations: capability-based retrieval so only relevant package knowledge enters context
cache verified documentation summaries and compiled skill cards by exact version
reuse shared environments and dependency layers when safe
prefer adapters/LoRA over full fine-tuning when they meet the target
prefer retrieval/tool use over weight training when knowledge changes frequently
prefer smaller verified models for bounded tasks
quantize only after quality regression testing
resume from checkpoints instead of restarting
curriculum/sample difficult or informative examples instead of blindly training on everything
measure tokens/second, examples/second, GPU/CPU memory, energy-relevant runtime, storage, wall time and actual cost
auto-stop experiments that cannot beat baseline within approved budget
reuse benchmark/evaluation packs across compatible models
promote broadly useful optimizations into shared fleet infrastructure

technique_mastery_and_commercialization.goal: Turn lawful, independently verified engineering know-how into DreamCo products, services, training packages and U.S.-based technical capability.
allowed: benchmark and learn from public papers, standards, model cards, open-source implementations and license-permitted code
sell DreamCo-authored tooling, training workflows, adapters, evaluation packs and services when underlying licenses permit
teach users reproducible techniques and engineering practices
publish benchmarks and interoperability standards with provenance
forbidden: selling third-party code/weights/data in violation of license or terms
using stolen/leaked/restricted model weights or datasets
claiming ownership of techniques or code DreamCo did not create
training on private/copyrighted data without appropriate rights or lawful basis

model_training_research.international_learning_rule: Study Chinese and other international open-weight model techniques from public lawful evidence, reproduce measurable ideas independently where appropriate, and benchmark them against DreamCo/U.S. implementations without copying restricted proprietary material.

guardrails: do not promise that every open-source library can legally become a redistributed training package
do not ingest entire ecosystems blindly; index broadly and deeply verify packages on demand/priority
do not train on user private data without explicit authorization and clear retention/export/deletion controls
do not include secrets, credentials or unintended PII in training packages
do not execute untrusted package install scripts outside isolation
do not treat generated/synthetic data as ground truth without validation
do not publish a package without provenance, license and reproducible verification
do not claim a trained model improved unless held-out evaluation demonstrates the improvement
do not let training overwrite the user's previous working model/bot without versioning and rollback
success_metrics: time from library discovery to verified skill package
time from user goal to first trained adapter/skill
new useful products/inventions created from package combinations
